tooltip: Camera Settings - Allows you to customize  camera-related functionalities such as brightness, contrast, saturation, exposure, white-balance and wdr
content1: The Camera Settings Configuration allows you to customize  camera-related functionalities such as brightness, contrast, saturation, exposure, white-balance and wdr
content2:
1. The PropertyRange structure holds information about a controls value range, including its ID, minimum, maximum, current and step, and default values, as well as the control mode (auto or manual). 
2. The CameraProperty Enum indicates the specific control for which value has to be extracted.
struct2:
enum CameraProperty {
	PropertyBrightness = 0,
	PropertySaturation,
	PropertyContrast,
	PropertySharpness,
	PropertyExposureAuto,
	PropertyExposureTime,
	PropertyAntiFlicker,
	PropertyMaxExposureTime,
	PropertyMinExposureTime,
	PropertyGain,
	PropertyWhiteBalanceAuto,
	PropertyWhitBalanceYrGain,
	PropertyWhitBalanceYbGain,
	PropertyWDR,
	PropertyBackLightCompensation
};
getAPIDes: This function will get the Camera Control values of the respective control id passed
setAPIHeading: Result SetCameraControlProperty(CameraProperty gControlID, const std::string& currentValue)
setAPIDes: This function will set the Camera Control values of the respective control id passed
